text.text_excerpt: What a wonderful-little-gem-of-a-place-I-never-would've-gone-into-when-they-allowed-smoking.... So, thank you to the smoking ban. Because this place is wondermints. Lotsa different beers on tap and in bottles. The draft beers are $6, which is a bit expensive. (They probably make a killing during Jazz Fest.) Walking in, the music is suuuuuuuuuuuuuuuper loud, but it adds to the character. Def a locals haunt, with some pretty groovy regulars. They have decent bar food and the bartender was knowledgeable and friendly. They have a great stage area, so I'm sure the live music scene is great at this bar. Pool table, lots of seating and a jukebox.

Don't eat the food at night. Everytime i've been they have not replaced the grease during the evening. That's the only reason they lost a star. The drink specials here are incredibly reasonable. It's comparable to Ms. Mae's as far as prices are concerned. It's also right across the street from the race track/casino, if you're into that type of thing. I always run into employees from the casino after they get off from work, and they are all pretty nice, not just because I went to college with a few of them, but they all have that warm N.O. attitude. They also have a really nice jukebox with an acceptable balance of modern and old school selections. Nice, friendly lil neighborhood spot to j...
My little neighborhood bar. Where everybody knows my name. I should have a hundred check ins. Great drinks... Decent bar food. Would give it 5 stars, but sometimes the crowd can be too much.
